-- Adjustable TabWindow -- TabWindow code by Mudlet Wiki -- other functions -- by Edru 10th October 2020 -- https://github.com/Edru2/AdjustableTabWindow Adjustable = Adjustable or {} Adjustable.TabWindow = Adjustable.TabWindow or Geyser.Container:new({name = "AdjustableTabWindowClass"}) local tab_pos = nil function Adjustable.TabWindow:createBaseContainers() self.tabBar = self.tabBar or Geyser.Label:new({ name = self.name.."tabBar", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = self.tabBarHeight, },self) self.tabBar:setStyleSheet(self.tabBarStyle) self.header = self.header or Geyser.HBox:new({ name = self.name.."header", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", },self.tabBar) self.overlay = self.overlay or Geyser.Label:new({ name = self.name.."overlay", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", },self.tabBar) self.overlay:setStyleSheet(self.overlayStyle) self.overlay:setMoveCallback(function(event) self:onOverlayMove(event) end) self.overlay:setOnLeave(function(event) self:onOverlayLeave(event) end) self.overlay:setClickCallback(function(event) self:onOverlayClick(event) end) self.overlay:hide() self.footerContainer = self.footerContainer or Geyser.Container:new({ name = self.name.."footerContainer", x = 0, y = self.tabBarHeight, width = "100%", height = "-0", },self) self.footer = self.footer or Geyser.Label:new({ name = self.name.."footer", x = 0, y = self.gap, width = "100%", height = "-0", },self.footerContainer) self.footer:setStyleSheet(self.footerStyle) end local function setTabToolTip(tab) -- put ToolTip on Label if TabText is to long to display local w,h = calcFontSize(tab.adjLabel.fontSize) local txt_width = #tab.tabText * w if tab.adjLabel:get_width() < txt_width then tab.adjLabel:setToolTip(tab.tabText) else tab.adjLabel:resetToolTip() end end -- function to create new tabs in tabs table or to rewrite/readjust them function Adjustable.TabWindow:createTabs() for k,v in ipairs(self.tabs) do self[v.."center"] = self[v.."center"] or Geyser.Label:new({ name = v.."center", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", },self.footer) self[v.."center"]:setStyleSheet(self.centerStyle) local tabText = self[v] and self[v].tabText or v self[v] = self[v] or Adjustable.Container:new({ name = self.name.." Tab: "..v, tabname = v, origin = self, noLimit = true, tabText = tabText, padding = 0, locked = true, autoSave = false, autoLoad = false, raiseOnClick = false, adjLabelstyle = self.inactiveTabStyle, titleTxtColor = self.tabTxtColor }, self.header) self[v]:setTitle("", self.TabTxtColor) self[v].titleText = "  "..tabText self[v].adjLabel:echo(tabText, self.TabTxtColor) self[v]:newLockStyle("tab", function(self) self.Inside:resize("-"..self.padding,"-"..self.padding) self.Inside:move(self.padding, self.padding*2) end) self[v].lockStyle = "tab" self[v].unlockContainer = function() Adjustable.Container.unlockContainer(self[v]) self[v]:setTitle("", self.tabTxtColor) self[v].titleText = ("  "..self[v].tabText) self[v].adjLabel:echo(self[v].tabText, "nocolor", "c") end Adjustable.TabWindow.allTabs[v] = self self[v]:newCustomItem("Tabify", function() Adjustable.TabWindow.allTabs[v]:createTempWindow(self[v]) end) self[v].reposition = self.reposition local delIndex = table.index_of(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, self[v].name) if delIndex then table.remove(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, delIndex) end Adjustable.Container.all[self[v].name] = nil self[v].adjLabelstyle = self.inactiveTabStyle self[v].titleTxtColor = self.tabTxtColor self[v].adjLabel:setStyleSheet(self.inactiveTabStyle) self[v].adjLabel:echo(self[v].tabText, "nocolor", "c") self[v].adjLabel:setClickCallback(function(event) self:onClick(v, event) end) self[v].adjLabel:setReleaseCallback(function(event) self:onRelease(v, event) end) self[v].adjLabel:setMoveCallback(function(event) self:onMove(v, event) end) self[v].adjLabel:setDoubleClickCallback(function(event) self:onDoubleClick(v, event) end) self[v].minimizeLabel:setClickCallback(function() self:onMinimizeClick(v) end) self[v].minimizeLabel:echo("
🗗
") self[v].minLabel:setClickCallback(function() self:onMinimizeClick(v) end) self[v.."center"]:hide() -- put ToolTip on Label if TabText is to long to display setTabToolTip(self[v]) end end --- Sets the amount of space to use between the tabs and the consoles -- @tparam number gap Number of pixels to keep between the tabs and consoles function Adjustable.TabWindow:setGap(gap) local gapNumber = tonumber(gap) local gapType = type(gap) assert(gapType == "number", "gap expected as number, got " .. gapType) self.gap = gapNumber self.footer:move(0, gapNumber) end --- Sets the height of the tabs in pixels/percent -- @tparam number tabHeight the height of the tabs for the object, in pixels/percent function Adjustable.TabWindow:setTabHeight(tabHeight) self.tabBarHeight = tabHeight self.tabBar:resize("100%", tabHeight) self.footerContainer:move(0, tabHeight) self.footerContainer:resize("100%", "-0") end --- Sets the CSS to use for the tab box which contains the tabs for the object -- @tparam string css The css styling to use for the tab box function Adjustable.TabWindow:setTabBarCSS(css) local cssType = type(css) assert(cssType == "string", "css as string expected, got " .. cssType) self.tabBarStyle = css self.tabBar:setStyleSheet(self.tabBarStyle) end --- Sets the color to use for the tab box background -- @param color Color string suitable for decho or hecho, or color name eg "purple", or table of colors {r,g,b} function Adjustable.TabWindow:setTabBarColor(color) self.tabBarColor = color self.tabBarStyle = "" self.tabBar:setStyleSheet(self.tabBarStyle) self.tabBar:setColor(self.tabBarColor) end --- Sets the FG color for the active tab -- @param color Color string suitable for decho or hecho, or color name eg "purple", or table of colors {r,g,b} function Adjustable.TabWindow:setActiveTabFGColor(color) local found local add_css local r, g, b = Geyser.Color.parse(color) local rgb = string.format("rgb(%s, %s, %s)",r,g,b) self.activeTabFGColor = color self.activeTabStyle, found = string.gsub(" "..self.activeTabStyle, "(%scolor:).-(;)","%1"..rgb.."%2") if found == 0 then if string.match(self.activeTabStyle,"QLabel{") then add_css = "\nQLabel{color:"..rgb..";}" else add_css = "\ncolor:"..rgb..";" end self.activeTabStyle = self.activeTabStyle..add_css end self:adjustTabStyle() end --- Sets the FG color for the inactive tab -- @param color Color string suitable for decho or hecho, or color name eg "purple", or table of colors {r,g,b} function Adjustable.TabWindow:setInactiveTabFGColor(color) local found local add_css self.inactiveTabFGColor = color local r, g, b = Geyser.Color.parse(color) local rgb = string.format("rgb(%s, %s, %s)",r,g,b) self.inactiveTabStyle, found = string.gsub(" "..self.inactiveTabStyle, "(%scolor:).-(;)","%1"..rgb.."%2") if found == 0 then if string.match(self.inactiveTabStyle,"QLabel{") then add_css = "\nQLabel{color:"..rgb..";}" elseif string.match(self.inactiveTabStyle,"QLabel::!hover{") then add_css = "" self.inactiveTabStyle = string.gsub(self.inactiveTabStyle, "(QLabel::!.-)(})","%1".."color:"..rgb..";".."%2") else add_css = "\ncolor:"..rgb..";" end self.inactiveTabStyle = self.inactiveTabStyle..add_css end self:adjustTabStyle() end --- Sets the BG color for the active tab. --
NOTE: If you set CSS for the active tab, it will override this setting. -- @param color Color string suitable for decho or hecho, or color name eg "purple", or table of colors {r,g,b} function Adjustable.TabWindow:setActiveTabBGColor(color) self.activeTabBGColor = color local r, g, b = Geyser.Color.parse(color) local rgba = string.format("rgba(%s, %s, %s, %s)",r,g,b,"100%%") self.activeTabStyle = string.gsub(self.activeTabStyle, "(background%-color:.-).-(;)","%1 "..rgba.."%2") self:adjustTabStyle() end --- Sets the BG color for the inactive tab. --
NOTE: If you set CSS for the inactive tab, it will override this setting. -- @param color Color string suitable for decho or hecho, or color name eg "purple", or table of colors {r,g,b} function Adjustable.TabWindow:setInactiveTabBGColor(color) self.inactiveTabBGColor = color local r, g, b = Geyser.Color.parse(color) local rgba = string.format("rgba(%s, %s, %s, %s)",r,g,b,"100%%") self.inactiveTabStyle = string.gsub(self.inactiveTabStyle, "(background%-color:.-).-(;)","%1 "..rgba.."%2") self:adjustTabStyle() end function Adjustable.TabWindow:adjustTabStyle() local abg_rgb = string.match(self.activeTabBGColor, "%d+.-%d+.-%d+") local ibg_rgb = string.match(self.inactiveTabBGColor, "%d+.-%d+.-%d+") for k,v in ipairs(self.tabs) do if v == self.current then self[v].adjLabelstyle = self.activeTabStyle self[v].adjLabel:setStyleSheet(self.activeTabStyle) if abg_rgb then self[v].adjLabel:setColor("<"..abg_rgb..">") else self[v].adjLabel:setColor(self.activeTabBGColor) end else self[v].adjLabelstyle = self.inactiveTabStyle self[v].adjLabel:setStyleSheet(self.inactiveTabStyle) if ibg_rgb then self[v].adjLabel:setColor("<"..ibg_rgb..">") else self[v].adjLabel:setColor(self.inactiveTabBGColor) end end end end --- sets the font for all tabs --- @tparam string font the font to use. function Adjustable.TabWindow:setTabFont(font) self.tabFont = font for k,v in ipairs(self.tabs) do self[v].adjLabel:setFont(font) end end --- sets the font for a single tab. If you use setTabFont this will be overridden --- @tparam string tabName the tab to change the font of --- @tparam string font the font to use for that tab function Adjustable.TabWindow:setSingleTabFont(tabName, font) local funcName = "EMCO:setSingleTabFont(tabName, font)" if not table.contains(self.tabs, tabName) then error("tabName must be an existing tab") end self[tabName].adjLabel:setFont(font) end -- finds the right position to drop the tab into function Adjustable.TabWindow:findPosition(tab) local myWindow = Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow or self local x, w = myWindow.get_x(), myWindow.get_width() local total = w/#myWindow.tabs local tab_x = tab.get_x() - x local position = (tab_x/total) + 1 position = math.floor(position + 0.5) if position < 1 then position = 1 end if position > #myWindow.tabs then position = #myWindow.tabs + 1 end return position end -- checks if 2 elements collide local function checkCollision(x1,y1,w1,h1, x2,y2,w2,h2) if x1 < x2+w2 and x2 < x1+w1 and y1 < y2+h2 and y2 < y1+h1 then return true end end local function getFloatingWindows() local floatingWindows = {} for k,v in pairs(Adjustable.TabWindow.allTabs) do if v[k].floating then floatingWindows[k] = v[k] end end return floatingWindows end -- checks if your tab collides with one of the tabwindows function Adjustable.TabWindow:checkMultiCollision(tab) local floatingWindows = getFloatingWindows() local x1, y1, w1, h1 = tab:get_x(), tab:get_y(), tab:get_width(), tab:get_height() for k,v in pairs(floatingWindows) do local x2, y2, w2, h2 = v:get_x(), v:get_y(), v:get_width(), v:get_height() if checkCollision(x1,y1,w1,h1, x2,y2,w2,h2) and v.windowname == self.windowname and not(v.hidden or v.auto_hidden) and not (v == tab) and not v.locked then return "floating", v end end for k,v in pairs(Adjustable.TabWindow.all) do local x2, y2, w2, h2 = v:get_x(), v:get_y(), v:get_width(), v:get_height() if checkCollision(x1,y1,w1,h1, x2,y2,w2,h2) and v.windowname == self.windowname and not(v.hidden or v.auto_hidden) then return "TabWindow", v end end end -- onMove function -- contains all the functionality to move the tab (collision check, make space ...) function Adjustable.TabWindow:onMove(tab, event) self[tab]:onMove(self[tab].adjLabel, event) self[tab].adjLabel:setAlignment("c") if self[tab].floating or not Adjustable.TabWindow.clicked then return end local result, value = self:checkMultiCollision(self[tab]) if Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow and Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow ~= value and not Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow.floating then -- reset the tab space self:makeSpace(Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow, nil, true) end if result == "TabWindow" then Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow = value tab_pos = value:findPosition(self[tab]) self:makeSpace(value, tab_pos) return end if result == "floating" and not(value.locked) then Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow = value return end if Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow then Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow = nil end end --- Transforms a floating Tab into a temporary TabWindow -- @tparam tab the tab which will be transformed function Adjustable.TabWindow:createTempWindow(tab, tempName) if tab and not(tab.floating) then return end local rnd_nr = 0 for i=0,#Adjustable.TabWindow.all_windows do if not Adjustable.TabWindow.all["tempTabWindow"..i] then rnd_nr = i break end end local window = tab and tab.windowname ~= "main" and Geyser.windowList[tab.windowname.."Container"].windowList[tab.windowname] or Geyser local tempWindowName = tempName and "tempWindow"..string.match(tempName,"%d+") or "tempWindow"..rnd_nr local tempTabWindowName = tempName or "tempTabWindow"..rnd_nr local x, y, width, height = 0,0,100,100 if tab then x, y, width, height = tab:get_x(), tab:get_y(), tab:get_width(), tab:get_height() end local tempWindowConf = { name = tempWindowName, titleText = "", x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height, autoSave = false, autoLoad = false, } tempWindowConf = table.union(tempWindowConf, self.tempWindowConf) local windowCont = Adjustable.Container:new(tempWindowConf) windowCont:move(x, y) windowCont:resize(width, height) table.remove(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, table.index_of(Adjustable.Container.all_windows, windowCont.name )) Adjustable.Container.all[windowCont.name] = nil local tabWindow = Adjustable.TabWindow:new({ name = tempTabWindowName, x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", tabTxtColor = self.tabTxtColor, tabPadding = self.tabPadding, activeTabFGColor = self.activeTabFGColor, inactiveTabFGColor = self.inactiveTabFGColor, activeTabBGColor = self.activeTabBGColor, inactiveTabBGColor = self.inactiveTabBGColor, tabBarColor = self.tabBarColor, tabBarStyle = self.tabBarStyle, color1 = self.color1, color2 = self.color2, tabBarHeight = self.tabBarHeight, footerStyle = self.footerStyle, centerStyle = self.centerStyle, inactiveTabStyle = self.inactiveTabStyle, activeTabStyle = self.activeTabStyle, chosenTabStyle = self.chosenTabStyle, overlayStyle = self.overlayStyle, gap = self.gap, temporary = true }, windowCont) --save name to get the style on loading tabWindow.tempStyle = self.tempStyle or self.name if tab then self:restoreTab(tab.tabname, tabWindow) tab.tempWindow = windowCont tab.tempTabWindow = tabWindow tab.tempWindow:changeContainer(window) tab.tempWindow:setPercent(true, true) end windowCont:show() windowCont.tabWindow = tabWindow return windowCont end -- mouse movement on the overlay label function Adjustable.TabWindow:onOverlayMove(event) Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow = self local tab = Adjustable.TabWindow.clickedTab.name if Adjustable.TabWindow.clickedTab ~= self.header.windowList[tab] then -- need to feed values to findPosition local fakeTab = {} fakeTab.get_x = function() return event.x + self.header.get_x() end tab_pos = self:findPosition(fakeTab) self:makeSpace(self, tab_pos) end end -- reset tabspace after mouse leaves overlay label and resets the currentWindow function Adjustable.TabWindow:onOverlayLeave(event) Adjustable.TabWindow.currentWindow = nil if not(Adjustable.TabWindow.doubleClick) then return end local tab = Adjustable.TabWindow.clickedTab.name if Adjustable.TabWindow.clickedTab ~= self.header.windowList[tab] then self:makeSpace(nil, nil, true) end end -- reset the Overlay label to be hidden local function resetOverlay() local tab = -- CSSMan by Vadi. Public domain.
CSSMan = {} CSSMan.__index = CSSMan
function CSSMan.new(stylesheet) local obj = { stylesheet = {} } setmetatable(obj,CSSMan) local trim = string.trim
assert(type(stylesheet) == "string", "CSSMan.new: no stylesheet provided. A possible error is that you might have used CSSMan.new, not CSSMan:new")
for line in stylesheet:gmatch("[^\n]+") do local attribute, value = line:match("^(.-):(.-);$") if attribute and value then attribute, value = trim(attribute), trim(value) obj.stylesheet[attribute] = value end end
return obj end
function CSSMan:set(key, value) self.stylesheet[key] = value end
function CSSMan:get(key) return self.stylesheet[key] end
function CSSMan:getCSS(key) local lines, concat = {}, table.concat for k,v in pairs(self.stylesheet) do lines[#lines+1] = concat({k,": ", v, ";"}) end return concat(lines, "\n") end
function CSSMan:gettable() return self.stylesheet end
function CSSMan:settable(tbl) assert(type(tbl) == "table", "CSSMan:settable: table expected, got "..type(tbl))
self.stylesheet = tbl end

-- SK condition ladder: text fragment -> remaining HP% bracket dmg.ladder = { {pat = "without a scratch", hi = 100, lo = 100}, {pat = "in excellent condition", hi = 100, lo = 100}, {pat = "in perfect health", hi = 100, lo = 100}, {pat = "is unharmed", hi = 100, lo = 100}, {pat = "has a few scratches", hi = 100, lo = 90}, {pat = "small wounds and bruises", hi = 89, lo = 75}, {pat = "quite a few wounds", hi = 74, lo = 50}, {pat = "several large nasty wounds", hi = 49, lo = 25}, {pat = "looks pretty hurt", hi = 25, lo = 10}, {pat = "is in awful condition", hi = 10, lo = 0}, }
function dmg.load() local t = {} local ok = pcall(table.load, PkgPath .. "dmgData.lua", t) if ok and t.data then dmg.data = t.data end end
function dmg.save() table.save(PkgPath .. "dmgData.lua", {data = dmg.data}) end
function dmg.onHit() if not dmg.active then return end dmg.hits = dmg.hits + 1 dmg.render() end
function dmg.onCondition(txt) if not dmg.active then return end for _, c in ipairs(dmg.ladder) do if string.find(txt, c.pat, 1, true) then table.insert(dmg.checkpoints, {hits = dmg.hits, mid = (c.hi + c.lo) / 2}) dmg.lastSeenCond = c.pat break end end dmg.render() end
function dmg.onDeath() if not dmg.active then return end if dmg.hits == 0 then dmg.checkpoints = {} return end local w, e, N = dmg.weapon, dmg.enemy, dmg.hits local simpleRate = 100 / N local rates = {simpleRate} for _, cp in ipairs(dmg.checkpoints) do local denom = N - cp.hits if denom > 0 then table.insert(rates, cp.mid / denom) end end local s = 0 for _, r in ipairs(rates) do s = s + r end local calRate = s / #rates
dmg.data[w] = dmg.data[w] or {} local d = dmg.data[w][e] or {kills = 0, totalHits = 0, calSum = 0, simpleSum = 0, best = N, worst = N} d.kills = d.kills + 1 d.totalHits = d.totalHits + N d.calSum = d.calSum + calRate d.simpleSum = d.simpleSum + simpleRate d.best = math.min(d.best, N) d.worst = math.max(d.worst, N) dmg.data[w][e] = d

dmg.hits = 0 dmg.checkpoints = {} dmg.lastSeenCond = nil dmg.render() end

function dmg.undo() if not dmg.lastKill then cecho("<white>[dmg] Nothing to undo.
") return end local k = dmg.lastKill local d = dmg.data[k.weapon] and dmg.data[k.weapon][k.enemy] if d then d.kills = d.kills - 1 d.totalHits = d.totalHits - k.hits d.calSum = d.calSum - k.calRate d.simpleSum = d.simpleSum - k.simpleRate if d.kills == 0 then dmg.data[k.weapon][k.enemy] = nil end end dmg.lastKill = nil dmg.save() cecho("<white>[dmg] Last kill removed from the record.
") dmg.render() end

" o[#o + 1] = string.format("<steel_blue>Weapon: <white>%s
<steel_blue>Enemy: <white>%s
", dmg.weapon, dmg.enemy) o[#o + 1] = string.format("<steel_blue>This fight: <white>%d hits", dmg.hits) if dmg.lastSeenCond then o[#o + 1] = " <grey>(" .. dmg.lastSeenCond .. ")" end o[#o + 1] = "

" if dmg.lastKill then local k = dmg.lastKill o[#o + 1] = string.format("<grey>Last kill: %s vs %s
 %d hits | simple %.1f%%/hit | cal %.1f%%/hit

", k.weapon, k.enemy, k.hits, k.simpleRate, k.calRate) end o[#o + 1] = "<dark_orange>Recorded averages:<reset>
" o[#o + 1] = "<grey>----------------------------------------
" for w, enemies in pairs(dmg.data) do for e, d in pairs(enemies) do local avgHits = d.totalHits / d.kills o[#o + 1] = string.format("<gold>%s <grey>vs <white>%s

", d.kills, avgHits, d.simpleSum / d.kills, d.calSum / d.kills, d.best, d.worst) end end DmgConsole:cecho(table.concat(o)) end

Script.script: -- SK Mapper Fixes (lives in skmudlet so it survives generic_mapper self-updates) -- The generic_mapper ships a "Exit Line Trigger" that is a child of the DISABLED -- multi-line-exits trigger, but was left isActive=yes. Script.name: sk_autodoors
Script.script:
-- SK Auto-Doors: SK marks a closed door as e(closed) and shows a bare direction e when -- that door is open; it never distinguishes locked from closed. So we ONLY auto-mark CLOSED -- doors, and we NEVER overwrite a door the user has manually set to locked (locks are managed -- by hand). Bare/open directions are left untouched (the door location stays remembered on the -- map, and normal exits never get a door). Listens to the mapper's onNewRoom event (public -- API) and applies to map.currentRoom via native setDoor once the mapper has placed the room. -- Additive; never edits the generic_mapper package. local sk_dirNorm = { u = "up", d = "down" } local sk_validdirs = { n=true, e=true, s=true, w=true, ne=true, se=true, sw=true, nw=true, up=true, down=true, ["in"]=true, out=true }
function sk_autodoors(_, exits) if type(exits) ~= "string" or exits == "" then return end local closed = {} for d0 in exits:gmatch("(%a+)%(closed%)") do local d = sk_dirNorm[d0] or d0 if sk_validdirs[d] then closed[d] = true end end if not next(closed) then return end tempTimer(0, function() local room = map and map.currentRoom if not room or not roomExists(room) then return end local existing = getDoors(room) or {} for dir in pairs(closed) do if existing[dir] ~= 3 then -- 3 = locked: preserve doors you locked by hand setDoor(room, dir, 2) -- 2 = closed end end updateMap() end) end registerAnonymousEventHandler("onNewRoom", "sk_autodoors")

Script.name: sk_data
Script.script:
-- SK Data: ONE database (Database_skdata.db) with normalized, indexed sheets. -- See .reference/database/README.md. db:create is idempotent, runs unguarded at top level; -- adding a NEW sheet later (e.g. an items sheet) just creates it (only column ALTER is broken). -- Rows snapshot room_name + area_name from the mapper so the data is portable/shareable. -- Compound-unique keys + REPLACE give free upsert for skill/item rows (needs Mudlet 4.20+). skdata = db:create("skdata", { rooms = { room_id = 0, room_name = "", area_name = "", short_desc = "", long_desc = "", note = "", _index = { "area_name" }, _unique = { "room_id" }, _violations = "REPLACE", }, trainer_skills = { room_id = 0, room_name = "", area_name = "", mob_name = "", skill = "", cost = "", _index = { "skill", "mob_name", "area_name" }, _unique = { { "room_id", "mob_name", "skill" } }, _violations = "REPLACE", }, shop_items = { room_id = 0, room_name = "", area_name = "", mob_name = "", item = "", cost = "", _index = { "item", "mob_name", "area_name" }, _unique = { { "room_id", "mob_name", "item" } }, _violations = "REPLACE", }, })
SKDB = SKDB or {}
function SKDB.room() return map and map.currentRoom end
-- room name + area name from the mapper, for snapshotting into rows function SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) local name = (getRoomName and getRoomName(room_id)) or "" local area = "" local aid = getRoomArea and getRoomArea(room_id) if aid and getAreaTableSwap then area = getAreaTableSwap()[aid] or "" end return name or "", area or "" end
-- bulk-load an array of field tables into a sheet inside ONE transaction (fast for thousands). -- Use this when converting a Lua table to the db. Returns ok, err. function SKDB.bulkAdd(sheet, rows) db:_begin() local ok, err = pcall(function() for _, row in ipairs(rows) do db:add(sheet, row) end end) if ok then db:_commit() else db:_rollback() end return ok, err end
-- ================= rooms (extended map notes) ================= function SKDB.getRoom(room_id) if not room_id then return nil end return db:fetch(skdata.rooms, db:eq(skdata.rooms.room_id, room_id))[1] end
function SKDB.ensureRoom(room_id) local r = SKDB.getRoom(room_id) if not r then local name, area = SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) db:add(skdata.rooms, { room_id = room_id, room_name = name, area_name = area, short_desc = "", long_desc = "", note = "" }) r = SKDB.getRoom(room_id) end return r end
function SKDB.setNote(room_id, text, mode) -- mode: "append" (default) | "replace" | "clear" if not room_id then return end local r = SKDB.ensureRoom(room_id) if not r then return end if mode == "clear" then r.note = "" elseif mode ~= "replace" and r.note ~= "" then r.note = r.note .. "
" .. (text or "") else r.note = text or "" end db:update(skdata.rooms, r) end
function SKDB.setDesc(room_id, short, long) -- for the description-capture trigger (later phase) if not room_id then return end local r = SKDB.ensureRoom(room_id) if not r then return end if short ~= nil then r.short_desc = short end if long ~= nil then r.long_desc = long end local name, area = SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) if name ~= "" then r.room_name = name end if area ~= "" then r.area_name = area end db:update(skdata.rooms, r) end
function SKDB.showRoom(room_id) room_id = room_id or SKDB.room() if not room_id then cecho("<firebrick>[skdb] No current room.
") return end local name, area = SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) cecho(string.format("<gold>== Room %d == <grey>%s / %s<reset>
", room_id, area ~= "" and area or "?", name ~= "" and name or "?")) local r = SKDB.getRoom(room_id) if not r then cecho("<grey>(no entry yet)
") return end if r.long_desc ~= "" then cecho("<steel_blue>description:<reset>
") decho(r.long_desc .. "
") end cecho("<steel_blue>note:
<white>" .. ((r.note ~= "" and r.note) or "<grey>(none)") .. "
") end
-- ================= trainer_skills (one row per skill) ================= function SKDB.addTrainerSkill(room_id, mob, skill, cost) if not room_id or not mob or not skill then return end local name, area = SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) db:add(skdata.trainer_skills, { room_id = room_id, room_name = name, area_name = area, mob_name = mob, skill = skill, cost = cost or "" }) end
function SKDB.getTrainers(room_id) if not room_id then return {} end return db:fetch(skdata.trainer_skills, db:eq(skdata.trainer_skills.room_id, room_id), { skdata.trainer_skills.mob_name, skdata.trainer_skills.skill }) end
function SKDB.whoTrains(skill) -- cross-room query: who teaches this skill anywhere return db:fetch(skdata.trainer_skills, db:like(skdata.trainer_skills.skill, "%" .. skill .. "%"), { skdata.trainer_skills.area_name, skdata.trainer_skills.room_name }) end
function SKDB.showTrainers(room_id) room_id = room_id or SKDB.room() if not room_id then cecho("<firebrick>[skdb] No current room.
") return end local rows = SKDB.getTrainers(room_id) cecho(string.format("<gold>== Trainers in room %d ==<reset>
", room_id)) if not rows[1] then cecho("<grey>(none)
") return end local curmob for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.mob_name ~= curmob then cecho("<dark_orange>" .. r.mob_name .. "
") curmob = r.mob_name end cecho(string.format(" <white>%-28s <yellow>%s
", r.skill, r.cost)) end end
-- ================= shop_items (one row per item; item may hold color) ================= function SKDB.addShopItem(room_id, mob, item, cost) if not room_id or not mob or not item then return end local name, area = SKDB.roomMeta(room_id) db:add(skdata.shop_items, { room_id = room_id, room_name = name, area_name = area, mob_name = mob, item = item, cost = cost or "" }) end
function SKDB.getShops(room_id) if not room_id then return {} end return db:fetch(skdata.shop_items, db:eq(skdata.shop_items.room_id, room_id), { skdata.shop_items.mob_name }) end
function SKDB.whoSells(item) -- cross-room query: who sells this item anywhere return db:fetch(skdata.shop_items, db:like(skdata.shop_items.item, "%" .. item .. "%"), { skdata.shop_items.area_name, skdata.shop_items.room_name }) end
function SKDB.showShops(room_id) room_id = room_id or SKDB.room() if not room_id then cecho("<firebrick>[skdb] No current room.
") return end local rows = SKDB.getShops(room_id) cecho(string.format("<gold>== Shops in room %d ==<reset>
", room_id)) if not rows[1] then cecho("<grey>(none)
") return end local curmob for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.mob_name ~= curmob then cecho("<dark_orange>" .. r.mob_name .. "
") curmob = r.mob_name end -- item may contain color codes captured by triggers; echo raw for now echo(" " .. r.item .. " ") cecho("<yellow>" .. r.cost .. "
") end end

Script.name: sk_desc
Script.script:
-- Room description capture: stores the lines between the room title and the exits line -- as a colored DECHO string in rooms.long_desc (keyed by mapper room_id). decho renders in -- the console and can be converted to html later (decho2html). See .reference/database. skDesc = skDesc or { auto = true }
-- Convert the console line at absolute line number y into a decho string (reads each -- character's fg colour via selectSection+getFgColor). SK descriptions are ASCII. function SKDB.lineToDecho(y) local plain = getLines(y, y + 1)[1] or "" if plain == "" then return "" end if not moveCursor(0, y) then return plain end local out, prev = {}, nil for i = 1, #plain do if selectSection(i - 1, 1) then local r, g, b = getFgColor() local key = string.format("%d,%d,%d", r or 255, g or 255, b or 255) if key ~= prev then out[#out + 1] = "<" .. key .. ">" prev = key end end out[#out + 1] = plain:sub(i, i) end deselect() return table.concat(out) end
-- Walk up from an exits line collecting the description (lines between title and exits) as decho. -- Boundary above the title is the blank line SK prints before the room title. function SKDB.grabDescAt(exitsY) if not exitsY then return nil end local title = map and map.currentName if not title or title == "" then return nil end local block, found = {}, false for y = exitsY - 1, math.max(0, exitsY - 30), -1 do local plain = getLines(y, y + 1)[1] or "" if plain:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") == title then found = true break end -- room title = top boundary (excluded) if plain:match("^%[HP:") or plain:match("^> ") then break end -- prompt safety boundary table.insert(block, 1, y) end if not found then return nil end while block[#block] do -- trim trailing blank/minimap-padding lines local last = getLines(block[#block], block[#block] + 1)[1] or "" if last:match("%S") then break end table.remove(block) end if not block[1] then return nil end local out = {} for i = 1, #block do out[#out + 1] = SKDB.lineToDecho(block[i]) end return table.concat(out, "
") end
-- Auto capture (called from the exits trigger; cursor is on the exits line). -- First-visit only: won't overwrite an existing description (use 'savedesc' to force). function SKDB.captureDesc() if skDesc.auto == false then return end local exitsY = getLineNumber() tempTimer(0, function() local rid = map and map.currentRoom if not rid then return end local r = SKDB.getRoom(rid) if r and r.long_desc ~= "" then return end local decho = SKDB.grabDescAt(exitsY) if decho then SKDB.setDesc(rid, nil, decho) end end) end
-- Force capture from the most recent room block in scrollback (the 'savedesc' alias). function SKDB.saveDesc() local cur = getLineNumber() local exitsY for y = cur, math.max(0, cur - 60), -1 do local plain = getLines(y, y + 1)[1] or "" if plain:match("^Obvious exits:") then exitsY = y break end end if not exitsY then cecho("<orange>[skdb] No recent room block (Obvious exits:) in scrollback.
") return end local decho = SKDB.grabDescAt(exitsY) if not decho then cecho("<orange>[skdb] Couldn't extract a description (mapper room title: '" .. tostring(map and map.currentName) .. "').
") return end local rid = map and map.currentRoom if not rid then cecho("<firebrick>[skdb] No current room.
") return end SKDB.setDesc(rid, nil, decho) cecho(string.format("<cyan>[skdb] Saved description for room %d.
", rid)) end

Script.name: sk_maptags
Script.script:
-- SK Map Tags: colored terrain symbols (legend 1) + kingdom background colours (legend 2). -- Native Mudlet room APIs (setRoomChar / setRoomCharColor / setRoomEnv) + room userData -- (stored in the map file, so it ships with the map and is searchable via searchRoomUserData). SKMap = SKMap or {}
-- terrain name -> { sym = symbol, c = {r,g,b} } | { env = envID, c = {r,g,b} } for background-fill water SK_TERRAIN = { ["plains"] = { sym = "p", c = {0,255,0} }, ["forest"] = { sym = "f", c = {0,128,0} }, ["heavy forest"] = { sym = "F", c = {0,128,0} }, ["fields"] = { sym = "y", c = {255,255,0} }, ["hills"] = { sym = "h", c = {0,255,0} }, ["valley"] = { sym = "v", c = {0,255,0} }, ["mountains"] = { sym = "^", c = {128,128,0} }, ["snowy mountains"] = { sym = "^", c = {255,255,255} }, ["snow"] = { sym = "s", c = {255,255,255} }, ["jungle"] = { sym = "J", c = {0,128,0} }, ["swamp"] = { sym = "y", c = {0,128,0} }, ["desert"] = { sym = "d", c = {255,255,0} }, ["beach"] = { sym = "b", c = {255,255,0} }, ["river"] = { sym = "r", c = {0,0,255} }, ["lake"] = { sym = "l", c = {0,0,128} }, ["reef"] = { sym = "r", c = {255,0,255} }, ["whirlpool"] = { sym = "@", c = {0,0,128} }, ["waterfall"] = { sym = "w", c = {255,255,255} }, ["lava"] = { sym = "L", c = {255,0,0} }, ["city"] = { sym = "%", c = {255,255,255} }, ["entrance"] = { sym = "#", c = {255,255,255} }, ["landmark"] = { sym = "?", c = {255,255,255} }, ["bridge"] = { sym = "=", c = {128,128,0} }, ["crossroads"] = { sym = "+", c = {128,128,0} }, ["shallow ocean"] = { env = 280, c = {0,128,128} }, ["deep ocean"] = { env = 281, c = {0,0,128} }, }
-- kingdom name -> { env = envID, c = {r,g,b} } SK_KINGDOM = { ["empire of the bright star"] = { env = 273, c = {128,128,128} }, ["taslamar"] = { env = 274, c = {0,128,128} }, ["zhenshi"] = { env = 275, c = {255,255,0} }, ["ayamao"] = { env = 276, c = {0,128,0} }, ["uxmal"] = { env = 277, c = {128,0,0} }, ["northern wastes"] = { env = 278, c = {255,0,0} }, ["deep realms"] = { env = 279, c = {128,0,128} }, }
-- register the custom environment colours once (env IDs 273+ are free; 1-16 & 257-272 reserved) function SKMap.initEnv() for _, k in pairs(SK_KINGDOM) do setCustomEnvColor(k.env, k.c[1], k.c[2], k.c[3], 255) end setCustomEnvColor(280, 0, 128, 128, 255) setCustomEnvColor(281, 0, 0, 128, 255) end SKMap.initEnv()
function SKMap.room() return map and map.currentRoom end
-- prefix-match input against a table's keys -> key, or (nil, {candidates}) function SKMap.match(tbl, input) input = (input or ""):lower():gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") if input == "" then return nil, {} end if tbl[input] then return input end local m = {} for name in pairs(tbl) do if name:sub(1, #input) == input then m[#m + 1] = name end end table.sort(m) if #m == 1 then return m[1] end return nil, m end
function SKMap.options(tbl) local names = {} for n in pairs(tbl) do names[#names + 1] = n end table.sort(names) return table.concat(names, ", ") end
function SKMap.setTerrain(rid, input) if not rid then cecho("<firebrick>[skmap] No current room.\n") return end local key, cand = SKMap.match(SK_TERRAIN, input) if not key then if cand and #cand > 1 then cecho("<orange>[skmap] Ambiguous terrain '" .. input .. "': <grey>" .. table.concat(cand, ", ") .. "\n") else cecho("<orange>[skmap] Unknown terrain. Options: <grey>" .. SKMap.options(SK_TERRAIN) .. "\n") end return end local t = SK_TERRAIN[key] if t.env then setRoomEnv(rid, t.env) -- ocean = background fill, no symbol setRoomChar(rid, " ") else setRoomChar(rid, t.sym) setRoomCharColor(rid, t.c[1], t.c[2], t.c[3]) end setRoomUserData(rid, "terrain", key) updateMap() decho(string.format("<0,255,255>[skmap] <255,255,255>room %d terrain = <%d,%d,%d>%s<255,255,255> (%s)\n", rid, t.c[1], t.c[2], t.c[3], t.sym or "fill", key)) end
function SKMap.setKingdom(rid, input, wholeArea) if not rid then cecho("<firebrick>[skmap] No current room.\n") return end local key, cand = SKMap.match(SK_KINGDOM, input) if not key then if cand and #cand > 1 then cecho("<orange>[skmap] Ambiguous kingdom '" .. input .. "': <grey>" .. table.concat(cand, ", ") .. "\n") else cecho("<orange>[skmap] Unknown kingdom. Options: <grey>" .. SKMap.options(SK_KINGDOM) .. "\n") end return end local k = SK_KINGDOM[key] local rooms = { rid } if wholeArea and map and map.currentArea then rooms = getAreaRooms(map.currentArea) or { rid } end local n = 0 for _, id in pairs(rooms) do setRoomEnv(id, k.env) setRoomUserData(id, "kingdom", key) n = n + 1 end updateMap() decho(string.format("<0,255,255>[skmap] <255,255,255>kingdom = <%d,%d,%d>%s<255,255,255> on %d room(s)\n", k.c[1], k.c[2], k.c[3], key, n)) end
function SKMap.clearTerrain(rid) if not rid then return end setRoomChar(rid, " ") if unsetRoomCharColor then unsetRoomCharColor(rid) end clearRoomUserDataItem(rid, "terrain") updateMap() end
function SKMap.info(rid) if not rid then cecho("<firebrick>[skmap] No current room.\n") return end local terr = getRoomUserData(rid, "terrain") local king = getRoomUserData(rid, "kingdom") cecho(string.format("<gold>== Room %d map tags ==<reset>\n", rid)) if terr ~= "" and SK_TERRAIN[terr] then local c = SK_TERRAIN[terr].c decho(string.format("<192,192,192>terrain: <%d,%d,%d>%s\n", c[1], c[2], c[3], terr)) else cecho("<steel_blue>terrain: <grey>(unset)\n") end if king ~= "" and SK_KINGDOM[king] then local c = SK_KINGDOM[king].c decho(string.format("<192,192,192>kingdom: <%d,%d,%d>%s\n", c[1], c[2], c[3], king)) else cecho("<steel_blue>kingdom: <grey>(unset)\n") end end
-- ===== auto-inherit: propagate kingdom/terrain to newly-mapped rooms while you walk ===== skInherit = skInherit or { kingdom = false, terrain = false, lastRoom = nil }
function SKMap.applyTerrain(rid, key) local t = SK_TERRAIN[key]; if not t then return end if t.env then setRoomEnv(rid, t.env) setRoomChar(rid, " ") else setRoomChar(rid, t.sym) setRoomCharColor(rid, t.c[1], t.c[2], t.c[3]) end setRoomUserData(rid, "terrain", key) end function SKMap.applyKingdom(rid, key) local k = SK_KINGDOM[key]; if not k then return end setRoomEnv(rid, k.env) setRoomUserData(rid, "kingdom", key) end
function SKMap.loadConfig() local t = {} if pcall(table.load, PkgPath .. "skmap_config.lua", t) then skInherit.kingdom = t.kingdom and true or false skInherit.terrain = t.terrain and true or false end end function SKMap.saveConfig() table.save(PkgPath .. "skmap_config.lua", { kingdom = skInherit.kingdom, terrain = skInherit.terrain }) end SKMap.loadConfig()
-- on entering a new room, fill any MISSING tag from the room we came from function SKMap.onRoom() local rid = map and map.currentRoom if not rid then return end local from = skInherit.lastRoom if from and from ~= rid then local changed = false if skInherit.kingdom and getRoomUserData(rid, "kingdom") == "" then local k = getRoomUserData(from, "kingdom") if k ~= "" and SK_KINGDOM[k] then SKMap.applyKingdom(rid, k) changed = true end end if skInherit.terrain and getRoomUserData(rid, "terrain") == "" then local t = getRoomUserData(from, "terrain") if t ~= "" and SK_TERRAIN[t] then SKMap.applyTerrain(rid, t) changed = true end end if changed then updateMap() end end skInherit.lastRoom = rid end function SKMap_onNewRoom() tempTimer(0, function() SKMap.onRoom() end) end if not SKMap._reg then registerAnonymousEventHandler("onNewRoom", "SKMap_onNewRoom") SKMap._reg = true end
function SKMap.inherit(which, state) if which == "on" then skInherit.kingdom = true skInherit.terrain = true SKMap.saveConfig() elseif which == "off" then skInherit.kingdom = false skInherit.terrain = false SKMap.saveConfig() elseif which == "kingdom" or which == "terrain" then if state == "on" then skInherit[which] = true elseif state == "off" then skInherit[which] = false else skInherit[which] = not skInherit[which] end SKMap.saveConfig() end cecho(string.format("<cyan>[skmap] auto-inherit kingdom:%s terrain:%s<reset>\n", skInherit.kingdom and "<green>on<cyan>" or "<firebrick>off<cyan>", skInherit.terrain and "<green>on<cyan>" or "<firebrick>off<cyan>")) end
